meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制真实浏览器，自动执行打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、获取页面文本等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要访问网站、填写在线表单、保存网页截图、测试网站功能或从网页提取信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com 并截图。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器访问该网址并保存截图。

say.text: 填写登录表单，用户名为 admin，密码为 123456。
say.note: Claude 会自动定位表单元素并填入内容。

say.text: 提取当前页面所有链接的网址。
say.note: Claude 会获取页面链接并返回列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a real browser to automatically open webpages, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract text from pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to visit a website, fill an online form, save a webpage screenshot, test a website feature, or extract data from a page.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the browser and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill the login form with username admin and password 123456.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the form fields and input the values.

say_en.text: Extract all links from the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will collect URLs and return them.
